targets.new_route_scope: One fresh public web search using the exact seller-card names AZ ONE and 青龙·赤子 plus frame/carbon/material terms. Open at most one exact product item returned by that query. Stop if exact identity is not established; do not repeat the prior 50-area sweep or continue to sibling models.
acceptance_requirements: The opened source must identify AZ ONE / 青龙·赤子 specifically and distinguish it from AZone, 青龙 TT or other HUANYU products.
A material-detail value must go beyond generic carbon, titanium or alloy; preserve the source's claim class and wording such as fiber grade, lay-up or construction.
Prefer an exact manufacturer source. A seller claim may be recorded only with explicit attribution and caveat; do not convert it into a verified engineering fact.
Do not infer material from price, appearance, adjacent models, or a generic HUANYU product family.
A search snippet without an inspectable attributable exact-model page is not accepted.
excluded_routes: other HUANYU models or unlinked AZone / 青龙 TT pages
generic carbon labels, unsupported grade inference or appearance-based claims
login, private message, seller contact or purchase

done_criteria: Use one fresh exact-name public web search and open at most one exact product item.
If accepted, add one dated exact source and populate only the supported candidate material detail with claim class and source caveat.
If unresolved, append a concise retry attempt with a one-route campaign_extension to the prior blocked 50-area field and this frozen scope; preserve all earlier evidence.
Run focused research validation and the full repository gate once for any data or research-attempt change; no images are in scope.
